Like every Nomu, he was made from a human body by Daruma Ujiko, who lives as Kyudai Garaki, in labs hidden beneath Jaku General Hospital, and All For One, the man Tomura Shigaraki calls Sensei, gave him his Quirks. Canon never establishes who he was; never invent or hint at an identity, and nothing of that person remains. On screen he shows only flight and the strength to carry a person; give him no other power.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf106\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[669,{\"name\":\"Secret Note: Hood\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf107\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-number\",\"key\":\"currentDay\",\"operator\":\"greaterThanOrEqual\",\"value\":1}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Narrator only (part of the All For One secret). Like every Nomu, Hood was made from a human body by Daruma Ujiko, who lives as Kyudai Garaki, in labs hidden beneath Jaku General Hospital, and All For One, the man Tomura Shigaraki calls Sensei, gave him his Quirks. He belongs to the doctor's stronger line, the High-End Nomu, which keep enough intelligence to adapt in a fight and say a few words. Canon never establishes who he was; never invent it, and he remembers no past life.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Reference lists credit him with further Quirks whose mechanics are never shown; add none. When and where he is released is the story's to decide.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf107\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[670,{\"name\":\"Secret Note: Endeavor\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf108\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-number\",\"key\":\"currentDay\",\"operator\":\"greaterThanOrEqual\",\"value\":1}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Narrator only (big secret 5, Dabi's identity). Touya Todoroki, Endeavor's eldest son, is alive: he is the burn-scarred villain who calls himself Dabi, working alone at the start of the year. Touya was Endeavor's first attempt at a child who could surpass All Might. He inherited his father's fire at a greater heat, blue flames that his body, built more like his mother's, could not withstand. When the flames kept burning him, Endeavor stopped training him and told him to give it up, and once Shoto showed both fire and ice, Endeavor poured everything into Shoto. Touya kept training alone on Sekoto Peak, desperate for his father to look at him again, until his own fire engulfed him there when Shoto was very small. The family believes he died in that fire and has mourned him since.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"He survived, burned over much of his body, and was kept alive by All For One's doctor, Kyudai Garaki. As Dabi he has purple burn scars stapled to the skin he has left, dyes his white hair black, and his blue flames burn him as they burn others. He hates Endeavor above all and means to destroy him by showing the world what his ambition cost his family; he resents Shoto as the child who replaced him.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Endeavor has no idea. He mourns Touya as dead and does not speak of him; at the start of the year he has never heard the name Dabi. Even when Dabi appears in the news or in front of him, nothing in Endeavor's manner hints at a link, and no one connects the two until the story itself reveals it. At the start of the year he knows no other big secret: nothing of All Might's injury or One For All, nothing of All For One, and nothing of Hawks' upbringing or any secret work Hawks takes on. Anything more reaches him only through the story.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf108\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[671,{\"name\":\"Secret Note: Hawks\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf109\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-number\",\"key\":\"currentDay\",\"operator\":\"greaterThanOrEqual\",\"value\":1}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Narrator only (big secret 4, Hawks' double role). Hawks' real name is Keigo Takami; the public has never heard it. He grew up poor and hidden: his father was a wanted criminal, a robber and killer who hid at home, and the boy was kept indoors and out of sight, with heroes on television, Endeavor above all, as his escape. As a small child he used his wings to save people in an accident, which brought him to the Hero Public Safety Commission's attention. His father was arrested, and the Commission took the boy in and buried his past.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"The Commission raised and trained him from childhood to be a hero who serves its ends: flight and combat drills, and the habit of putting public order before his own feelings. He earned his rank on his own speed, but in private he still answers to the Commission's President and puts her orders above any other loyalty. He believes in the goal, a society where heroes have free time, more than in the people who run the system. Only the Commission's top circle knows; Endeavor, other heroes and the public see a fast, cheerful hero with no past worth asking about.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"At the start of the year he has no contact with the League of Villains, and he knows nothing of One For All, All Might's injury, All For One or Dabi's identity unless the story tells him. His double role is the story's to play: only if and when the story reaches it, once the League has become a national threat, does the Commission order him inside the League as a double agent, with Dabi as his contact, while he passes what he learns to the heroes, Endeavor first. Inside, he plays the cynical defector even in front of heroes. Until the story shows it, he has no part in the League.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf109\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}]]"};let changed=false;for(const k of Object.keys(D)){if(storage[k]!==D[k]){storage[k]=D[k];changed=true;}}if(!changed)delete triggers["Pack: load 21"];})();
